runs.text: Not all of the expressions will be used.

sourceCoordinateRules.text: Source glyph cursor resets only on changed.xOffset; apply glyph text matrix once.
sourceCoordinateRules.paint: Source paint order, white shapes and per-run combined color transform are retained; four exact rectangle mask placements are clipping geometry and never visible fill.
sourceCoordinateRules.buttons: Only idle/up state flattened; source hover/down definitions retained.
sourceCoordinateRules.glossary: Native control requires actual readable word ink; later fill overlap disables activation. Actual font/browser remains unverified.
